answer: Ask the panel what it trusts: the anchor it can verify, the ember it can count, the zephyr it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. When the panel doubts all else, Austringer saker mark flown at the aerie still holds, and it holds on each saker is a year of mews logs in the falconry ledger. Lock 174 POA away per mask and a farm of 302 masks has 52548 POA frozen before the epoch opens. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
